responsibility: Provides the x86 CMPCCXADD intrinsic interface for conditional compare-and-add memory operations on x86_64. The header defines the condition-code enumeration used by the instruction and exposes optimized/macro forms of _cmpccxadd_epi32 and _cmpccxadd_epi64, mapping the operation to dedicated GCC builtins and making this file the public API for that specialized conditional atomic-style extension.
